title: Oracle Concerning Egypt

questions.question: Behold, the LORD is riding on a swift what and comes to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:1 (ESV): "riding on a swift cloud and comes to Egypt;"

questions.question: And the idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence, and the heart of the Egyptians will do what within them?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:1 (ESV): "and the heart of the Egyptians will melt within them."

questions.question: I will stir up Egyptians against Egyptians, and they will fight, each against another and each against his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:2 (ESV): "each against another and each against his neighbor,"

questions.question: And the waters of the sea will be dried up, and the river will be dry and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:5 (ESV): "and the river will be dry and parched,"

questions.question: The princes of Zoan are utterly what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:11 (ESV): "The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish;"

questions.question: The wisest counselors of Pharaoh give what counsel?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:11 (ESV): "the wisest counselors of Pharaoh give stupid counsel."

questions.question: The princes of Memphis are deluded; those who are the cornerstones of her what have led Egypt astray?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:13 (ESV): "those who are the cornerstones of her tribes"

questions.question: The LORD has mingled within her a spirit of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:14 (ESV): "The LORD has mingled within her a spirit of confusion,"

questions.question: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a what to the LORD at its border?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:19 (ESV): "and a pillar to the LORD at its border."

questions.question: When they cry to the LORD because of oppressors, he will send them a savior and defender, and deliver them. And the LORD will make himself what to the Egyptians?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:21 (ESV): "And the LORD will make himself known to the Egyptians,"

questions.question: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:23 (ESV): "In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria,"

questions.question: In that day Israel will be the third with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 19:24 (ESV): "a blessing in the midst of the earth,"

questions.question: Whom the LORD of hosts has blessed, saying, "Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my what?"
And the canals will become foul, and the branches of Egypt's Nile will diminish and dry up, reeds and rushes will do what?

key_verse_text: Whom the LORD of hosts has blessed, saying, "Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance."
